name: Microphones
description: EVENT: MICROPHONES — microphones.like.audio, 2,067 microphone and RF records with polar patterns, frequency plots, signal-chain diagrams and CSV export. The page ships no vocabulary of its own: every chip, column and dropdown is built at runtime from data/config.json, which docs/build_data.py generates from Research/microphones.json and docs/vocabulary.py. Nothing under docs/data/ is committed, so the page is blank until that build has run.
